subject: TOURN: display surface for placement badges (champion/runner-up/third)
description: Follow-on from 364. Placement badges are awarded, proven and revocable in users/{uid}/server_awards but NOTHING RENDERS THEM: TrophyCabinet reads AchievementRegistry which reads localStorage, and placements are deliberately kept OUT of users/{uid}.achievements because that array is union-merged on every sync and never subtracted (GUARD-04, after BUG-266) - a revoked id there is resurrected by any stale device. So the display surface must read server_awards directly and must honour placements[tid].revoked. Art already exists: _app/assets/images/badges/tournament_{champion,runner_up,third}.webp (copied from the medal-gold/silver/bronze icons). Design question to settle first: extend TrophyCabinet to read server_awards (touches every student's trophy wall) or build a separate tournament-history surface. Also open per Mallory: a concurrent-run race in ctfAwardTournamentBadges (admin-only, self-healing) worth closing with a per-uid batch.
